title: Adaptive, problem-tailored variational quantum eigensolver mitigates rough parameter landscapes and barren plateaus
problem_summary: Argues and demonstrates that ADAPT-VQE's problem-tailored, adaptively-grown ansatz mitigates both rough parameter landscapes and barren plateaus better than fixed-ansatz VQE, connecting the ADAPT-VQE family directly to the trainability concerns raised in mcclean2018.

components.family_or_name: ADAPT-VQE (problem-tailored, adaptively grown -- analyzed here specifically for trainability properties)
components.notes: Same ansatz family as grimsley2019, this paper's contribution is the trainability/barren-plateau analysis rather than a new growth mechanism.
Directly follows up on the trainability concern raised in mcclean2018.

workflow_composition_notes: Standard ADAPT-VQE adaptive-growth loop; paper's contribution is analytical/empirical evidence about the resulting optimization landscape's trainability rather than a new algorithmic component.
